about.subtitle: Cool Tips is a technical education brand and YouTube channel created by developers, for developers. We teach modern software engineering through clear, actionable, production-grade tutorials.
about.mission_quote: “We are software engineers who love programming and want to make robust backend engineering accessible to everyone through high-signal, zero-fluff video tips.”
about.why_desc: Most online tutorials either scratch only the surface or spend 20 minutes explaining elementary concepts before getting to the point. Cool Tips was born out of frustration with long, repetitive tutorials. We wanted a resource that developers can open during a workday to immediately learn a real technique and apply it to their codebase in minutes.
about.audience_desc: Whether you are a junior developer wanting to learn how senior engineers structure applications, or an experienced full-stack programmer looking to discover lesser-known Laravel features and performance tweaks, our tutorials are tailored for people building real software.
about.philosophy_subtitle: The four principles that guide every single video and tutorial we produce.
about.p1_desc: No 5-minute channel intros or repetitive filler. We dive straight into the problem and explain the solution with clear rationale.
about.p2_desc: We don’t just show what works in a demo; we explain edge cases, performance implications, and security considerations.
about.p3_desc: All tips are demonstrated using modern PHP 8.x, strict typing, current Laravel releases, and industry security guidelines.
about.p4_desc: Knowledge should be open. Our videos on YouTube and code stubs on GitHub are completely free for the global developer community.
about.tech_subtitle: Our core technological stack and subject matters.
about.community_desc: Subscribe to @coooltips on YouTube for newly uploaded programming tips, ask questions in the comments, and connect with other passionate engineers.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_text: Cool Tips (“we”, “our”, or “us”) operates the website at coooltips.com as well as the official Cool Tips YouTube channel (@coooltips). This Privacy Policy explains our practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal data when you visit our website.
privacy.s2_intro: We prioritize developer privacy and minimize data collection. We do not require you to create an account or provide personal details merely to browse our tutorials or view video listings.
privacy.s2_p1: Contact Form Data: When you send a message through our Contact page, we collect your name, email address, subject, and message text solely to respond to your inquiry.
privacy.s2_p2: Browser & Device Information: Standard server access logs (such as IP address, browser user-agent, operating system, and visited pages) for security monitoring and fraud prevention.
privacy.s2_p3: Local Preferences: We use your browser’s local storage to persist user-selected preferences, such as your theme preference (Dark Mode / Light Mode).
privacy.s3_text1: Our website embeds videos hosted on YouTube using official responsive embed mechanisms. When you load a page containing a YouTube player or interact with the player, YouTube (Google LLC) may collect data, set cookies, or track your interactions according to Google’s privacy policies.
privacy.s3_text2: We recommend reviewing Google's Privacy Policy and the YouTube Terms of Service.
privacy.s4_text: Our website contains links to external websites, including GitHub repositories, documentation sources, tools, and social media platforms. We have no control over the privacy practices of third-party websites and assume no responsibility for their content or data collection practices.
privacy.s5_text: Inquiries sent through our contact form are retained only for as long as necessary to address your communication. You have the right to request deletion or correction of any personal details you have transmitted to us by contacting our team.
privacy.s6_text: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or your data, please reach out via our Contact Page.

terms.title: Terms of Use

terms.s2_p1: The Cool Tips logo, branding, text descriptions, and presentation layout are the intellectual property of Cool Tips.
terms.s2_p2: Tutorial code snippets and demonstration source code released on our public GitHub repositories are provided for educational and development purposes. You are welcome to adapt code examples into your personal or commercial applications, provided you perform adequate testing and security audits before deploying to production.
terms.s3_text: Video content showcased on this website is streamed directly via YouTube’s official embed API. All video playback is subject to YouTube’s Terms of Service. This website does not store, host, or allow unauthorized downloading or redistributing of video media.
terms.s4_text: All tutorials, code patterns, and tips are provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis without warranty of any kind. While we make every effort to demonstrate verified best practices, software development carries inherent risks. You are responsible for validating and securing code implemented within your own technical environments.
terms.s5_text: Under no circumstances shall Cool Tips or its creators be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the use or inability to use this website or code snippets provided.
